domain_specific_rationale: From a Contracts and Schema Versioning standpoint, CP-011 establishes a clean separation between high-level prompt semantics (Semantic AST), provider-agnostic intermediate representation (Engine IR), and rendered provider payloads (Target Payload). In domain-entities.schema.json, the PromptVersion entity includes ast_snapshot (object) and parameters (object) alongside rendered positive_prompt and negative_prompt. This contract schema allows the prompt compiler (R05) to evolve intermediate directive syntax and AST transformations without introducing breaking changes to the immutable PromptVersion domain contract.
evidence_citations: review-session/FREEZE_REMEDIATION_V1/REVISED_SPEC_CANDIDATE/02_contracts/domain-entities.schema.json:lines 244-293 (PromptVersion schema with ast_snapshot, parameters, positive_prompt, negative_prompt)
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-05 (Prompt Compiler AST Synthesis) and CAP-06 (Assets & Continuity Invariants).
residual_risk: Unversioned changes within ast_snapshot internal AST dialects could impact deterministic prompt reproduction. Mitigated by storing schema_version within AST snapshot objects.
